title: A non-plain virtually free group with a strictly 2-geodetic Cayley graph
summary: We construct an explicit infinite virtually free group $G=C_4\ast_{C_2}D_3$ with a finite inverse-closed generating set whose Cayley graph is $2$-geodetic but not geodetic. More precisely, we describe the full language of geodesics and show that every element of $G$ has a unique geodesic representative except for a single element, which has exactly two. This gives a counterexample to the conjecture that an infinite group admitting a $k$-geodetic Cayley graph must admit a geodetic Cayley graph with respect to the same generating set.
